caption:
November still counts as fall, so there's time for one more pumpkin page. 🍂

The autumn book has 65 fall scenes in clean line art: a rocking chair on the porch, rain boots full of flowers, an old lantern among the pumpkins, a little footbridge over the stream.

New to coloring? Start with the 10 color-by-number pages for grown-ups, then move on to the scenes. There are 15 for kids too, if someone small wants to join you.

It's an 80-page print-ready PDF plus PNG files, US Letter, and it prints edge to edge on ordinary paper. Hit print. It fits.

altText: Four printed autumn coloring pages fanned out on a cream tablecloth: a fence with pumpkins, a woodland path with acorns, and a footbridge in the park. Around them sit orange and brown colored pencils, a small white pumpkin, wheat stalks, a bowl of acorns and dried maple leaves.
